endsDef.Stuck: no signed deal, no regime change, door under 30 ships/day, fighting continues
endsDef.Signed deal: a signed US–Iran agreement (not an MOU, not a pause)
endsDef.Regime change: any leadership change in Tehran, including an IRGC takeover or Khamenei succession
endsDef.Bigger war: US or Israeli strikes on Iranian territory sustained over a week, or a Gulf-wide exchange, or US ground forces engaged
endsDef.Strait regime: passage resumes ≥30 ships/day under Iran–Oman rules or fees, no war, no signed deal
endsDef.Other: anything else (Houthi Red Sea closure, US unilateral pause, etc.)
